summary: Iteration 3: Validated new features — boarding requests, QR bus attendance/scan, admin search+pagination+QR dialog. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend admin/driver/student flows verified end-to-end including WS live update of driver console when student sends boarding request and QR scan check-in.
passed: POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/boarding-requests: valid stop 200, duplicate returns same doc (idempotent), bad stop 400, missing/inactive trip 404
GET /api/trips/{trip_id}/boarding-requests: driver-own returns items+by_stop aggregate; other DRIVER 403; STUDENT sees own only
POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/boarding-requests/{req_id}/acknowledge: driver flips to acknowledged; student 403
POST /api/attendance/scan: valid scan 200 {ok:true,already:false}, duplicate returns already:true, invalid bus 404, idle bus 409
GET /api/trips/{trip_id}/attendance: driver-own and admin return {count,items}; other driver 403

Admin /admin/buses: buses-search live filter works (search 'BUS-01' -> 1 row), QR dialog opens on qr-bus-BUS-01 showing api.qrserver.com and code 'BUS-01'. Only 5 buses in seed -> pagination controls hidden (correct behaviour per PAGE_SIZE=8).

Driver dashboard shows Boarding Requests section + Boarded count card while trip active; when Priya sends boarding request for Civil Lines the driver UI updates within <5s via WS boarding:new — visible '1 pending' badge + 'Civil Lines · 1 waiting · 0 acknowledged · Priya Deshmukh'. Clicking Acknowledge removes the pending count.

Student /student/track/:tripId: request-board-btn opens per-stop dialog, click request-stop-Civil Lines -> success toast 'Notified driver'. scan-qr-btn opens dialog with scan-input pre-filled 'BUS-01' -> submit-scan-btn -> toast 'Checked in on BUS-01' and button switches to 'Boarded'. Server attendance count=1 for Amit Verma confirmed.

integration_issues.issue: If user clicks scan-qr-btn BEFORE the initial GET /trips/{id} resolves, scanCode is set to '' (trip?.bus?.bus_number is undefined). User must then manually type the code. Rare race; only observed on very fast interaction after route change.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria Description / aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console). Minor.

action_items: (Minor) Disable scan-qr-btn until `trip` state has loaded, OR fall back to reading bus_number from tripId path once fetched, so scanCode is never empty on first click.
(Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription to Dialogs in BusesPage QR dialog, BusTrackingPage boarding/scan dialogs, etc., to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Cleanup) BusTrackingPage.reloadMyAttendance() is a no-op — dead code, remove.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_boarding_requests: response typing is dict for admin/driver but for student also returns {items, by_stop:[]} — good consistency. However when trip status != ACTIVE this endpoint still returns data — acceptable but consider gating.
attendance.scan uses body.bus_number.strip().upper() but ScanBody has no validation length; consider min_length=1 in the model.
BusesPage QR image loaded from external api.qrserver.com — external dependency at admin runtime; consider server-side QR generation or caching to avoid third-party outage.
Frontend student BusTrackingPage.reloadMyAttendance is unreachable/no-op and myBoarded state does not survive page reload (no server sync). Minor UX polish.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_boarding_scan.py. Run with `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_boarding_scan.py -n 0` (serial required because trip-start creates shared driver state). All new endpoints validated. WS boarding:new event confirmed reaching driver UI within ~2s. Only cosmetic issues remain (dialog a11y, scan pre-fill race, dead reloadMyAttendance).
